subject: general
question: A train X crosses another train Y travelling in the opposite direction in 15 seconds. The speed of train Y was 72 km/h and the length of train Y is 80% of the length of train X. If train X was moving at a speed of 16 m/s, then the length (in m ) of train X is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of train Y = 72 km/h = 72 × (1000/3600) m/s = 20 m/s

Speed of train X = 16 m/s

Length of train Y = 0.8 × Length of train X

Time taken to cross each other = 15 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed when moving in opposite directions = Speed of Train X + Speed of Train
